records.title: editArcMark
records.summary: Edits arc geometry or appearance and rematerialize complete sector paths. stroke: false disables the outline and its width.

records.title: editAreaMark
records.summary: Edits constant area appearance. stroke: false removes an existing outline.

records.title: editBarMark
records.summary: Edits whole bar appearance and rematerialize every concrete rectangle. stroke: false removes the visible outline; constant fill conflicts with a field driven color encoding.

records.title: editBin2DData
records.summary: Revises the current or uniquely targeted logical two-dimensional bin-data owner.

records.title: editBoxPlot
records.summary: Revises box statistics, optional outlier topology, width, and component appearance through the stable box owner without addressing generated child IDs.

records.title: editCanvas
records.summary: Edits Canvas properties and rematerialize connected consumers.

records.title: editCompositionLayout
records.summary: Edits spacing, cross axis alignment, or outer padding on an existing composition. columns changes wrapping only on a facet composition and is rejected for concat.

records.title: editDensity
records.summary: Creates an immutable density-data revision, rebinds the selected density area, and rematerializes its graphical consumers; source, field, and groupBy may revise creation-time data roles, while groupBy: false removes grouping.

records.title: editErrorBand
records.summary: Revises one error band's interval data, area appearance, or optional boundary lines through its stable owner.

records.title: editErrorBandBoundary
records.summary: Edits or removes one error band's lower and upper boundary line appearance without changing its interval area.

records.title: editErrorBar
records.summary: Partially edits one error bar and its owned caps. statistics revises a statistical interval through immutable data; explicit interval owners reject that option. caps: false removes both caps and caps: true restores them.

records.title: editFacetGuides
records.summary: Changes facet axes between "each" and "outer", or legend ownership between false and "shared".

records.title: editFacetHeaders
records.summary: Edits the parent owned repeated facet headers and rebuild the parent snapshot without changing child programs or facet value order.

records.title: editFacetScales
records.summary: Changes used facet scale channels between "shared" and "independent" resolution.

records.title: editGradientPlot
records.summary: Revises the data, layout, statistics, or appearance of one gradient plot owner.

records.title: editGraphics
records.summary: Edits one validated graphical property or removes one named graphic subtree through the public extension primitive.

records.title: editGrid
records.summary: Edits one or both directional Cartesian grids through their focused grid actions.

records.title: editHorizon
records.summary: Creates and bind an immutable Horizon revision, preserve omitted settings and scale identities, and rematerialize affected consumers. groupBy: false removes grouping.

records.title: editHorizontalGrid
records.summary: Edits values or line appearance for one existing horizontal Cartesian grid.

records.title: editLegend
records.summary: Partially edits one existing legend; title accepts a non-empty string, "auto", or false, while semantic channel bindings remain unchanged.

records.title: editLegendBorder
records.summary: Edits or removes the border and background styling around one existing legend.

records.title: editLegendLabels
records.summary: Edits the label formatting and typography of one existing legend while preserving its symbols and channel bindings.

records.title: editLegendLayout
records.summary: Edits one legend's placement, orientation, spacing, and alignment without changing its semantic channels.

records.title: editLegendSymbols
records.summary: Edits symbol size, spacing, or appearance for one existing categorical legend.

records.title: editLegendTitle
records.summary: Edits or removes the title of one existing legend without changing its represented channels.

records.title: editLineMark
records.summary: Edits line appearance and rematerialize concrete path commands without changing semantic encodings.

records.title: editMarkSelection
records.summary: Replaces the complete selector while preserving the stored selection ID and mark target.

records.title: editPointMark
records.summary: Changes constant point shape, fill, opacity, or outline appearance and rematerialize its concrete items. stroke: false disables the outline and its width.

records.title: editRadialAxis
records.summary: Edits selected radial components; angle moves the whole axis.

records.title: editRadialAxisLabels
records.summary: Edits the text, placement, and style of radial value labels.

records.title: editRadialAxisLine
records.summary: Edits the color, width, and dash style of the radial baseline.

records.title: editRadialAxisTicks
records.summary: Edits radial tick values, geometry, and visual style.

records.title: editRadialAxisTitle
records.summary: Edits the radial title. position accepts "inside" or "outside" and defaults to the baseline midpoint inside the plot.

records.title: editRadialGrid
records.summary: Edits the values and appearance of one existing radial grid.

records.title: editRectMark
records.summary: Edits rect appearance and rematerialize complete cells.

records.title: editRegression
records.summary: Revises a fitted regression model and its band or line through the stable point owner.

records.title: editRegressionBand
records.summary: Edits the appearance of an existing regression interval band without refitting the statistical model.

records.title: editRegressionLine
records.summary: Edits the appearance of an existing regression line without refitting its statistical model.

records.title: editScale
records.summary: Revises one named scale and rematerializes every connected mark and guide without mutating the earlier program.

records.title: editSemantic
records.summary: Creates, replaces, or removes one supported semantic property path for extension-authored domain actions.

records.title: editTextMark
records.summary: Edits text typography and graphical offsets without changing its semantic source or position.

records.title: editThetaAxis
records.summary: Edits selected components of one existing theta axis.

records.title: editThetaAxisLabels
records.summary: Edits the text, placement, and style of perimeter theta labels.

records.title: editThetaAxisLine
records.summary: Edits the color, width, and dash style of the outer theta baseline.

records.title: editThetaAxisTicks
records.summary: Edits theta tick values, geometry, and visual style.

records.title: editThetaAxisTitle
records.summary: Edits the text, placement, and style of the theta axis title.

records.title: editThetaGrid
records.summary: Edits the values and appearance of one existing theta grid.

records.title: editTickMark
records.summary: Partially edits tick length or constant line appearance while preserving data, position, and other assignments.

records.title: editTitle
records.summary: Partially edits the existing title. subtitle: false removes the subtitle; omitted properties remain unchanged.

records.title: editVerticalGrid
records.summary: Edits values or line appearance for one existing vertical Cartesian grid.

records.title: editXAxis
records.summary: Edits selected components of one complete x axis while preserving omitted component settings.

records.title: editXAxisLabels
records.summary: Edits labels on one existing x axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: editXAxisLine
records.summary: Edits baseline on one existing x axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: editXAxisTicks
records.summary: Edits ticks on one existing x axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: editXAxisTicksAndLabels
records.summary: Edits coordinated ticks and labels on one existing x axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: editXAxisTitle
records.summary: Edits title on one existing x axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: editYAxis
records.summary: Edits selected components of one complete y axis while preserving omitted component settings.

records.title: editYAxisLabels
records.summary: Edits labels on one existing y axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: editYAxisLine
records.summary: Edits baseline on one existing y axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: editYAxisTicks
records.summary: Edits ticks on one existing y axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: editYAxisTicksAndLabels
records.summary: Edits coordinated ticks and labels on one existing y axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: editYAxisTitle
records.summary: Edits title on one existing y axis while preserving its other components.

records.title: encodeAngle
records.summary: Rotates point or Tick glyphs with direct clockwise degrees: 0 points up and no scale or legend is created.

records.title: encodeBarWidth
records.summary: Sets aggregate bar band occupancy or a fixed logical pixel width and materialize concrete rectangles.

records.title: encodeColor
records.summary: Mapss a field or constant to mark color, optionally grouping series and creating a categorical or continuous color scale.

records.title: encodeDensity
records.summary: Creates immutable KDE data, bind it to an area mark, encode its value and density fields, and materialize baseline closed paths.

records.title: encodeGroup
records.summary: Splits line or area paths by a nominal field without creating a scale or guide.

records.title: encodeHistogram
records.summary: Compose binned bar encodeX and count encodeY as one atomic histogram action.

records.title: encodeHorizon
records.summary: Creates immutable folded band data, bind it to an area mark, and author the ordinary x, y/y2, group, and color encodings needed for a compact Horizon chart.

records.title: encodeOpacity
records.summary: Applies a constant point or rule opacity from 0 to 1, or maps a quantitative field through a linear opacity scale.

records.title: encodeParallelCoordinates
records.summary: Atomically assign ordered dimensions and their local scales to one line mark.

records.title: encodePathOrder
records.summary: Orders vertices within each compatible Cartesian line or ranged-area series; fieldType defaults to "quantitative" and order defaults to "ascending".

records.title: encodePointRadius
records.summary: Applies a constant point glyph radius through a traced encodeRadius child.

records.title: encodeR
records.summary: Encodes a quantitative field as Polar radial distance.

records.title: encodeRadius
records.summary: Applies a constant rendered radius to an existing point mark.

records.title: encodeShape
records.summary: Encodes or replace a nominal field with the shared 12 value point shape vocabulary.

records.title: encodeSize
records.summary: Encodes or replace a quantitative field as equal area point size.

records.title: encodeStroke
records.summary: Assigns a constant non-empty stroke string to a rule mark.

records.title: encodeStrokeDash
records.summary: Creates or replace nominal line series or rule dash patterns, or apply one constant named/direct pattern.

records.title: encodeStrokeWidth
records.summary: Assigns a non negative finite logical Canvas width to a rule mark.

records.title: encodeText
records.summary: Assigns exactly one field or constant value to a text mark. format accepts "auto" or fixed decimal tokens from ".0f" through ".12f" .

records.title: encodeTheta
records.summary: Encodes Polar angle in clockwise degrees from 12 o'clock.

records.title: encodeX
records.summary: Creates or compatibly replaces an x-position encoding for the targeted mark and field type.

records.title: encodeX2
records.summary: Assigns an area, ranged bar, or rect upper edge, or a rule secondary x endpoint.

records.title: encodeXOffset
records.summary: Creates or compatibly update an advanced nominal offset scale within an ordinal bar x band.

records.title: encodeXRange
records.summary: Atomically composes area or ranged bar encodeX and encodeX2 .

records.title: encodeY
records.summary: Creates or compatibly replaces a y-position encoding for the targeted mark and field type.

records.title: encodeY2
records.summary: Assigns an area, ranged bar, or rect upper edge, or a rule secondary y endpoint.

records.title: encodeYOffset
records.summary: Creates or compatibly update the corresponding categorical offset scale within an ordinal bar y band.

records.title: encodeYRange
records.summary: Atomically composes area or ranged bar encodeY and encodeY2 .

records.title: facet
records.summary: Repeats one complete chart by a field on its common row preserving dataset ancestor.

records.title: filterData
records.summary: Creates an immutable named derived dataset using exactly one membership, comparison, or range filter.

records.title: filterMarks
records.summary: Retains matching final mark items through the shared selector grammar, create one namespaced immutable member row dataset, rebind the mark, and rematerialize its scales and connected guides without changing the source.

records.title: highlightMarks
records.summary: Selects point, bar, line, area, arc, or rule items inline or reuse a stored selection, then apply mark specific concrete emphasis, optional complement dimming, and selected last order.

records.title: jitterPoints
records.summary: Assigns deterministic bounded graphical jitter to one Cartesian point mark.

records.title: layoutLabels
records.summary: Assigns deterministic collision aware placement to one complete text mark.

records.title: orderCategories
records.summary: Assigns explicit or computed semantic order to a nominal/ordinal Cartesian x or y position.

records.title: removeCategoryOrder
records.summary: Removes one active category order assignment and restore automatic first appearance order.

records.title: removeEncoding
records.summary: Removes one active semantic encoding, its generated companions, matching guide blocks, and stale concrete values.

records.title: removeGrid
records.summary: Removess the complete Cartesian grid resource while retaining related axes, scales, and encodings.

records.title: removeJitter
records.summary: Removes the target point mark's jitter assignment and restore positions derived directly from its semantic encodings.

records.title: removeLabelLayout
records.summary: Removes one text mark's layout policy and leader collection, then restore its semantic base positions.

records.title: removeLegend
records.summary: Removes every legend block owned by one mark when channels is omitted, or removes selected channel blocks while preserving mark encodings, scales, and unrelated blocks.

records.title: removeMark
records.summary: Removes one stable mark owner and its owned state while preserving source data and independently shared resources.

records.title: removeMarkHighlight
records.summary: Removes one highlight assignment, restore the target mark and categorical legend baseline, and retain the reusable selection.

records.title: removeMarkSelection
records.summary: Releases one stored selection after removing its dependent highlight.

records.title: removePathOrder
records.summary: Removes explicit path topology and restore the mark's automatic independent position ordering.

records.title: removePointRadius
records.summary: Removes an explicit constant point glyph radius and restore the theme default.

records.title: removeRadialAxis
records.summary: Removes the complete radial axis and all of its owned components.

records.title: removeThetaAxis
records.summary: Removes the complete theta axis and all of its owned components.

records.title: removeTitle
records.summary: Removes the complete chart title and subtitle resource.

records.title: removeXAxis
records.summary: Removess one complete x axis without removing its position encoding, scale, or coordinate.

records.title: removeYAxis
records.summary: Removess one complete y axis without removing its position encoding, scale, or coordinate.

records.title: replaceCompositionChild
records.summary: Replaces one named child while preserving its slot ID and order.

records.title: selectMarks
records.summary: Stores a reusable semantic selection of final mark items without changing the current graphical output.

records.title: LLM Action Router
records.summary: Choose the result or resource being changed, then follow the linked canonical page. Use the complete action reference when an exact action name is already known. Exact signatures come from the reference and public TypeScript declarations, not from this routing page. For structured retrieval, use the complete machine-readable action metadata, which joins every current action to its exact signature, prerequisites, effects, errors, example, related actions, and canonical docs.

records.title: LLM Documentation Router
records.summary: Use this page for concepts, complete tutorials, detailed API behavior, rendering, troubleshooting, and extension work. For a known chart task use the recipe router; for a known capability use the action router.

records.title: LLM Guide
records.summary: Use this guide to reach the smallest authoritative ggaction documentation chunk for a chart-authoring task. These pages route to public documentation; they do not replace exact action signatures, behavior contracts, or runnable examples.

records.title: LLM Recipe Router
records.summary: Use a recipe when the requested chart or workflow is recognizable. A recipe gives the shortest supported action flow, required decisions, inferred state, and links to deeper tutorials or APIs. Use the recipe catalog if none of the groups below matches. For structured retrieval, use the complete machine-readable recipe metadata, which joins each task intent to ordered action roles, executable examples, related recipes, and complete 173-action coverage.
